# COMA — Command & Communication for Autonomous Agents

> Machine-readable specification and RAG context index for `ellmos-ai/coma`.<br>
> Last-checked: 2026-09-24<br>
> Verification: 290 passed Pytest unit & contract tests (100% green).<br>
> Execution Mode: Standard User Mode (`RunAsInvoker`) — Zero Administrative Elevation.<br>
> Attribution & Notice: [NOTICE](NOTICE) | [MIT License](LICENSE)<br>
> Statutory Notice: § 521 BGB Gefälligkeitsrecht applies.

## Overview

COMA (`coma`) is a zero-dependency, local-first **agent lifecycle layer and session-decoupled communication channel**. It manages how autonomous AI agents (such as Claude Code CLI, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity / AGY CLI, and Kimi Code CLI) are spawned as independent subprocesses, monitored during execution, and communicated with via a file-based job board protocol.

COMA operates purely on local files and standard processes—without external network services, databases, cloud servers, or user accounts. Zero external runtime dependencies (`INV-COMA-02`).

## Core Architecture & Responsibilities

| Layer | Responsibility | Handled By |
|---|---|---|
| **Lifecycle & Spawner** | Process creation, CLI argument formatting, subprocess execution, stdout/stderr logging | **COMA (`coma.spawner`, `coma.adapters`)** |
| **Decoupled Communication** | Session-independent job submission, progress tracking, status reporting, result retrieval | **COMA (`coma.protocol`, `coma.board`, `coma.runner`)** |
| **Session Planning** | Process-free argv planning for interactive and headless sessions with CLI reachability probes | **COMA (`coma.session`)** |
| **Starter Generation** | Dual-platform starter scripts (`START.bat`, `start.sh`) generated from `roles[]` manifests | **COMA (`coma.starters`)** |
| **Locking & Permissions** | File access rules, claim management (optional protocol integration) | `lock-master` / Roshambo |
| **Agent Memory** | Context retention, decision history, attempt tracking | `memoryhooker` / Roshambo |

## Target Personas

- **[PERSONA-01] Autonomous Agent Framework Engineers & Swarm Architects:** Designing multi-agent swarms, relay pipelines, or hierarchical agent networks.
- **[PERSONA-02] Local-First & Sovereign AI Developers:** Running AI developer toolchains locally on sovereign workstations and air-gapped systems without cloud telemetry.
- **[PERSONA-03] Remote Control & Headless Automation DevOps:** Orchestrating headless runs, scheduled tasks, or remote terminal sessions where interactive permission flags stall.
- **[PERSONA-04] Enterprise Security Officers & Systems Auditors:** Auditing software supply-chains for zero dependencies, non-elevation (`RunAsInvoker`), and 48h security SLAs.

## The File-Based Job Board Protocol

Job communication uses a directory structure (`_agentjobs/`) with distinct single-writer files to eliminate file-locking collisions across sessions:

```
IN/    <jobid>.md                       Job prompt / instruction (Markdown)
OUT/   <jobid>.result.md                Final result output from agent
       coma.<jobid>.json               Runner status (state: PENDING, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED)
       coma.<jobid>.from-agent.jsonl   Agent-to-runner event stream (.jsonl)
       coma.<jobid>.to-agent.jsonl     Runner-to-agent instruction stream (.jsonl)
       coma.<jobid>.console.log        Combined stdout / stderr log
DONE/  <jobid>.md                       Completed job prompt (moved upon success)
```

## CLI Adapters

COMA abstracts CLI flag differences into verified adapters:
- **`ClaudeAdapter`**: Formats flags for Anthropic Claude Code CLI (`-p`, `--permission-mode dontAsk`, `--allowedTools`, `--disallowedTools mcp__*`).
- **`CodexAdapter`**: Formats flags for OpenAI Codex CLI (`exec`, workspace-write, `--output-last-message`).
- **`AntigravityAdapter`**: Formats flags for Google Antigravity / AGY CLI (`agy`).
- **`KimiAdapter`**: Formats flags for Kimi Code CLI (fail-closed skeleton).

## Session Planning & Starters

- **`build_session_plan()`**: Constructs process-free argument lists for interactive or headless provider sessions (`Claude`, `Codex`, `AGY`, `Kimi`), keeping role prompts and requests separated.
- **`ordered_candidates()` / `available_candidates()`**: Deterministic provider fallback chain.
- **`probe()` / `build_probe_command()`**: Bounded, read-only reachability check with child-process cleanup.
- **`coma starters generate`**: Generates dual-platform `START.bat` and `start.sh` from module `roles[]` definitions with overwrite protection markers.

## Governance & 10 Runtime Invariants

- **INV-COMA-01 (Single Writer):** Exactly one writer per channel file; no distributed locking needed.
- **INV-COMA-02 (Zero Egress):** 0 network calls, 0 listening ports, standard library only.
- **INV-COMA-03 (Session Decoupling):** Spawner runs processes detached from interactive client sessions outside RC.
- **INV-COMA-04 (Process-Free Dry Runs):** Argv construction without starting processes or consuming tokens.
- **INV-COMA-05 (Deterministic CLI Fallback):** Multi-provider chains resolve binaries deterministically.
- **INV-COMA-06 (Fail-Closed Provider Safety):** Unverified adapters (Kimi) reject real prompt runs unless explicit opt-in.
- **INV-COMA-07 (Bounded Probes):** Reachability checks enforce timeouts and guarantee child-process cleanup.
- **INV-COMA-08 (Idempotent Starters):** Generated starters carry unique markers to prevent overwrites.
- **INV-COMA-09 (Unprivileged Execution):** Standard user mode execution (`RunAsInvoker`); zero root/admin elevation.
- **INV-COMA-10 (48h Security Response SLA):** Committed 48-hour response SLA and 5-business-day vulnerability triage.

## Quick Python API Usage

```python
from coma import JobBoard, JobRunner, ClaudeAdapter, Spawner, build_session_plan

# 1. Job Board Protocol
board = JobBoard(r"C:\jobs\_agentjobs")
board.submit("job123", "# Instruction\nPerform technical audit and write output to OUT/job123.result.md\n")

# 2. Run Job via Runner
runner = JobRunner(board)
result = runner.run("job123")

# 3. Direct Spawner Usage
adapter = ClaudeAdapter.preset("unattended")
spawner = Spawner(adapter)
handle = spawner.start("Audit code", log_file="audit.log")

# 4. Session Planning
plan = build_session_plan("codex", prompt_file="AGENTS.md", request="Audit code", mode="headless")
print(plan.command)
```

## Quick CLI Usage

```bat
coma --root C:\jobs\_agentjobs submit job123 --file prompt.md
coma --root C:\jobs\_agentjobs run job123 --dry-run
coma --root C:\jobs\_agentjobs status job123
coma --root C:\jobs\_agentjobs result job123
coma adapters
coma session --provider codex --prompt-file AGENTS.md --request "Audit" --dry-run
coma starters generate --manifest ellmos-module.v2.json --output-dir starters
coma check .\coma-vendor.json
```
